name: Trust Fall
tagline: The offsite planner for people who hate planning offsites.
positioning: Trust Fall runs your company retreat end to end — venues, RSVPs, dietary chaos, and the budget — so nobody has to build another 11-tab spreadsheet.

hero.h1: Your offsite. Minus the group text meltdown.
hero.sub: Book the cabin, wrangle the RSVPs, track who's gluten-free and who's just difficult, and keep the whole thing under budget — from one page instead of nine spreadsheets.

features.title: Venue shortlist, not venue rabbit hole
features.description: Tell us headcount, vibe, and budget. We surface three bookable spots with real availability so you stop opening 40 tabs at 11pm.

features.title: RSVPs that actually close
features.description: Nudges go out on autopilot until Dave from Sales finally clicks yes. Live headcount updates the second someone flakes.

features.title: Dietary chaos, contained
features.description: Collect allergies, preferences, and 'I'm doing keto this week' in one form, then hand the caterer a clean list they'll actually read.

features.title: Budget that doesn't ambush you
features.description: Every deposit, per-head cost, and surprise resort fee lands in one running total you can show your accountant without flinching.

features.title: Agenda people can find
features.description: Build the run-of-show once. Everyone gets it on their phone with times, rooms, and which session they can quietly skip.

features.title: One reusable playbook
features.description: Save this year's offsite as a template. Next year is a duplicate button, not a personality crisis.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose a full week to our annual offsite. This year I booked the whole thing between two client calls and still remembered to order the vegan lunches.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: The RSVP nudges alone paid for it. No more chasing 14 people in Slack while the venue deposit deadline stares at me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feldt

testimonials.quote: Our first offsite ran $4k over. With Trust Fall the running total kept me honest, and the resort fee didn't blindside me for once.
testimonials.name: Dana Okoro

pricing.blurb: For the owner planning their very first team getaway.
For growing teams that do this more than once a year.
For multi-location teams and the ops lead who plans them all.

homepage.footerBlurb: Trust Fall plans the corporate offsite so you can go back to running the actual company. Fewer spreadsheets, same open bar.
